title: Home page title leads with another town
plain_english: The page title that shows in Google starts with a different town's name instead of Carroll.

verify_template.assert: the other town's name no longer leads the page title

title: Page tells search engines not to list it
plain_english: A page that should appear in Google carries a hidden instruction telling Google to leave it out.

verify_template.assert: index,follow

title: Page points search engines at a different page
plain_english: A page tells Google that some other page is the real one, so this page may never be shown.

verify_template.assert: the page names its own address as its preferred address

title: Hidden business details carry a phone number other than the main number
plain_english: The business details hidden in the page for Google should show only the main number on all three sites, so a number not on the reviewed list is a finding while numbers still awaiting the owner's decision are only noted.

verify_template.assert: the hidden phone number is 712-792-5000, or one still awaiting the owner's decision

title: Hidden business details use a different business name
plain_english: The business name hidden in the page for Google is not the same on every site, so Google may treat them as different businesses.

verify_template.assert: the hidden business name matches the name the owner approved

title: No question-and-answer markup on the page
plain_english: The page has no hidden question-and-answer markup, so Google and AI assistants cannot easily lift answers from it.

verify_template.assert: the page carries question-and-answer markup

title: Page shows a phone number outside the approved list
plain_english: A page shows a phone number that is not on the approved list, so the owner has to rule on whether it stays.

verify_template.assert: the owner's ruling is recorded and the page matches it

title: A blank platform placeholder page sits at a real page address
plain_english: An address that should hold a real page is serving a blank placeholder page from the website platform.

verify_template.assert: the address shows the real page, not the platform placeholder

title: An old offer page is still live
plain_english: A page for an offer that has ended is still on the website where customers can find it.

verify_template.assert: the old offer page is gone or points to the current offers page

title: No list of pages for search engines
plain_english: The site does not offer search engines a list of its pages, so new pages may be found slowly.

verify_template.assert: the site offers a list of its pages to search engines

title: An AI assistant's crawler is turned away
plain_english: The site's access rules turn away a crawler that an AI assistant uses to read the site.

verify_template.assert: no access rule turns away the named AI crawlers

title: No plain guide file for AI assistants
plain_english: The site has no short plain-language guide that points AI assistants to the right pages.

verify_template.assert: the site offers a plain guide file for AI assistants

title: A Google listing is marked permanently closed
plain_english: One of our Google Business listings says the business is permanently closed, which can confuse customers and Google.

verify_template.assert: the listing no longer shows as permanently closed, or the owner has ruled to leave it

title: A duplicate Google listing exists
plain_english: More than one Google listing exists for the same business at the same address, which splits reviews and confuses Google.

verify_template.assert: only the intended listings remain for the address

title: Google listing has no booking link
plain_english: Our Google listing has no button that lets a customer book a visit online.

verify_template.assert: the listing shows a booking link that opens the right page

title: Google listing photos are very old
plain_english: The main photos on our Google listing have not been refreshed in years.

verify_template.assert: new photos are live on the listing

title: Google Business posts have stopped going live
plain_english: Posts have stopped reaching our Google listings, so customers see an old post as the newest.

verify_template.assert: a post dated this week is live on the listing

title: No new Google reviews for weeks
plain_english: A listing has gone weeks without a new customer review.

verify_template.assert: the review count has risen and the newest review is recent

title: Directory listings disagree with our details
plain_english: Some online directories show different business details from ours, which weakens trust with Google.

verify_template.assert: the named directories match the approved business details

title: A scheduled job still carries retired instructions
plain_english: An automated job still follows instructions that were retired, such as an old phone number or an old machine name.

verify_template.assert: the job's instructions no longer contain the retired text

title: An audit checks the wrong website
plain_english: A weekly audit looks at a test website instead of our real dealership sites, so its results do not describe what customers see.

verify_template.assert: the audit reads the three real dealership sites

title: Vehicles listed with no price
plain_english: Some vehicles are in our listings with a price of zero, so shoppers and AI assistants see no real price.

verify_template.assert: no vehicle in the feed has a zero price

title: Priced vehicles missing from the AI-readable copy
plain_english: Some priced vehicles are not showing in the copy of our inventory that AI assistants read.

verify_template.assert: every priced vehicle appears in the AI-readable copy

title: An AI assistant states a wrong fact about us
plain_english: An AI assistant gave an answer about the dealership that contains a fact that is not true.

verify_template.assert: a repeat of the same question returns the correct fact

title: A Google listing carries its own phone number
plain_english: A Google listing shows a phone number that differs from the main number, and the owner has to rule on which number it should show.

verify_template.assert: the listing shows the number the owner ruled on

title: Many search appearances but almost no clicks
plain_english: The site appears in Google thousands of times but almost nobody clicks, so something about how it appears is turning people away.

verify_template.assert: clicks have risen against the same level of search appearances

title: No scheduled check reads a site
plain_english: No automated check reads one of our dealership sites, so a problem there could go unnoticed for weeks.

verify_template.assert: the weekly check file covers all three sites

title: Finished page drafts are not published
plain_english: Pages that were drafted for the website have been waiting for months without going live.

verify_template.assert: the drafted pages are live or the owner has declined them

title: A ready request is waiting for the owner's OK
plain_english: A finished request is waiting for the owner's approval before it can go to the website company.

verify_template.assert: the owner has approved or declined the request

title: Google Business posts cannot be tracked
plain_english: Visits that come from our Google Business posts cannot be counted because the post links carry no tracking tag.

verify_template.assert: post links carry the agreed tracking tag

title: The AI-answer check counts a competitor as us
plain_english: The weekly check of AI answers can count a competitor named after our town as if it were us, so its results cannot be trusted.

verify_template.assert: the check matches only our own business name and addresses

title: A key page does not load
plain_english: An important page on our website is returning an error instead of loading for shoppers and search engines.
